name: exists_comparison_forms
summary: gl_ϑ = comparisonForm j ϑ, A = (goodLift 1 j)^* ∘ comparisonForm j 1 and γ(ϑ) = conj(κ(1)/κ(ϑ)), κ from cosetKernelSum_eq_fNatural; inner_adjoint_comparisonForm shows that the adjoints of gl_ϑ differ by the constants, eq_zero_of_integral_fNatural_tableTheta gives surjectivity, tableTheta_adjoint_eq_zero the testing.

steps.claim: Constants C and κ(ϑ) with |κ(ϑ)|² = C/heckeValueProd j ϑ (hn) and F♮_i = κ(ϑ)·cosetKernelSum whenever the matrix of i factors as u·w (e) (cosetKernelSum_eq_fNatural with a = CarrierIndex ⊕ BigIndex j).
steps.lean: choose _ κ hn e using cosetKernelSum_eq_fNatural (a := D.CarrierIndex ⊕ BigIndex j) j

steps.claim: Specialise e to u = (1 | 0) and w = stackOverGenScalar i.1, whose product is the matrix of i.
steps.lean:
replace e ϑ i g := e ϑ (.fromCols 1 0) i g ((splittingV j ϑ).stackOverGenScalar i.1)
    (by erw [Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromRows, Matrix.zero_mul]; simp)

steps.claim: κ(ϑ) ≠ 0: otherwise every F♮_i vanishes, so every good form on U(W_j) is 0 (eq_zero_of_integral_fNatural_tableTheta), contradicting dim rows ≠ 0 (finrank_rows_ne_zero, finrank_rows_eq_finrank_goodForms).
steps.lean:
have hκ ϑ : κ ϑ ≠ 0 := fun h ↦
    D.finrank_rows_ne_zero ((D.finrank_rows_eq_finrank_goodForms j).trans
    (finrank_zero_iff_forall_zero.2 (eq_zero_of_integral_fNatural_tableTheta · (by simp [e ϑ, h]))))

steps.claim: For every ϑ, inner_adjoint_comparisonForm with e (U).
steps.lean: have U ϑ := inner_adjoint_comparisonForm j ϑ (e ϑ)

steps.claim: Take γ(ϑ) = conj(κ(1)/κ(ϑ)), A = (goodLift 1 j)^* ∘ comparisonForm j 1 and gl_ϑ = comparisonForm j ϑ. (ii) holds since both sides have the same inner products with every F (U at ϑ and at 1, κ ≠ 0); (iii) A is surjective because a good form orthogonal to its range vanishes (eq_zero_of_integral_fNatural_tableTheta, with the integrals of step 7); (v) is comparisonForm_mem_integralForms; (vi) is normSqAt_comparisonForm_le; (i) and (iv) are steps 6 and 8.
steps.lean:
refine ⟨(conj <| κ 1 / κ ·), (D.goodLift _ j).adjoint ∘ₗ comparisonForm j 1, _, fun ϑ ↦ ?_,
    fun ϑ ↦ ext fun ζ ↦
    ext_inner_left ℂ fun F ↦ by simpa [inner_smul_right, hκ, field, mul_comm] using (U ϑ ..).trans
                                  (U 1 ..).symm, range_eq_top.1 (orthogonal_eq_bot_iff.1
    (bot_unique fun F m ↦ eq_zero_of_integral_fNatural_tableTheta F fun i ζ ↦ ?_)),
    fun ϑ F _ _ _ Ξ m ↦ ?_, comparisonForm_mem_integralForms j, normSqAt_comparisonForm_le j⟩

steps.claim: (i): γ(ϑ) ≠ 0 since κ ≠ 0, and γ(ϑ)/γ(1) = conj(κ(1)/κ(ϑ)), so |γ(ϑ)/γ(1)|² = |κ(1)|²/|κ(ϑ)|² = (C/heckeValueProd(1))/(C/heckeValueProd(ϑ)) = heckeValueProd(ϑ)/heckeValueProd(1) by hn (grind).
steps.lean:
· simp; clear * - hn hκ
    grind [Complex.ofReal_eq_zero, norm_eq_zero]

steps.claim: For surjectivity: if F is orthogonal to the range of A, then for every choice i and vector ζ the integral ∫conj(F·F♮_i)·tableTheta(ζ) vanishes, by U at the table equal to ζ at i and 0 elsewhere (only the term i survives; the Weil scalar and lineScale are nonzero).
steps.lean:
· have := (U ..).symm.trans (mul_eq_zero_of_right _
      (inner_eq_zero_symm.1 (m _ ⟨.toLp 2 fun b ↦ ite (b.1 = i) ζ 0 b.2, rfl⟩)))
    rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single i (by simp +contextual [tableTheta, ← modKernelBilin_apply])] at this
    simpa [(lineScale j).2.1, DividedLattice.weilScalar, NeZero.ne]

steps.claim: (iv): for y and a form Ξ as in IsTested, ⟨gl_ϑ(A^*y), Ξ⟩ is, by U at 1, a combination of integrals against tableTheta of gl_ϑ^*Ξ, which vanish by tableTheta_adjoint_eq_zero.
steps.lean:
· rw [← adjoint_inner_left, adjoint_inner_right, inner_eq_zero_symm]
    simpa [hκ, tableTheta_adjoint_eq_zero _ _ m] using U 1 F ((comparisonForm j ϑ).adjoint Ξ)
